roadmap.title: Finish the mainland story
roadmap.description: Complete the tutorial and mainland missions. Collect gear, levels, emeralds and enchantment points along the way. Plan ahead for the co-op task that requires the second day of a month.

roadmap.title: Unlock Apocalypse Plus
roadmap.description: Replay the campaign on Adventure and Apocalypse. Prepare enchanted equipment and complete mainland challenges.

roadmap.title: Explore the island expansions
roadmap.description: Complete Jungle Awakens, Creeping Winter and Howling Peaks, then replay their equipment and combat challenges.

roadmap.title: Explore the Nether and Ancient Hunts
roadmap.description: Complete Flames of the Nether and its secret missions. Work on Ancient Hunts, gold, merchants and co-op tasks.

roadmap.title: Explore Hidden Depths
roadmap.description: Complete underwater missions and their oxygen, equipment and combat challenges.

roadmap.title: Finish Echoing Void
roadmap.description: Explore the Stronghold and End missions, then finish the End equipment and movement challenges.

roadmap.title: Climb the Tower and earn seasonal rewards
roadmap.description: Play Tower layouts and weekly challenges while progressing the selectable seasonal adventures. Use seasonal cosmetics for their related achievements.

roadmap.title: Finish remaining challenges
roadmap.description: Complete Treetop Tangle, merchant and pet tasks, then finish remaining combat counters.

achievements.description: Revive a downed friend 20 times.
achievements.summary: Revive another player 20 times.

steps.text: Play co-op and revive a fallen teammate until you have performed 20 revives.
For local co-op, connect a second controller. In @loc{Redstone Mines}, clear the enemies beside a minecart track, let the second player fall to the carts, and revive that player.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 mobs.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies.

steps.text: Defeat enemies during missions until your total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Defeat 2,500 mobs.
achievements.summary: Defeat 2,500 enemies.

steps.text: Keep clearing enemies during your missions until you have defeated 2,500.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 passive mobs.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 passive animals.

steps.text: Kill cows, pigs, or sheep in @loc{Creeper Woods} or @loc{Pumpkin Pastures} until you have killed 50 passive animals.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enchanted mobs.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enchanted enemies.

steps.text: Kill enemies while their enchantments are active. Enemies connected to an Enchanter by a purple beam count; keep the connection intact until the enemy dies.

achievements.description: Reach Level 10.
achievements.summary: Raise your hero to level 10.

steps.text: Earn experience by defeating enemies and completing missions until your hero reaches level 10.

achievements.description: Reach Level 25.
achievements.summary: Raise your hero to level 25.

steps.text: Continue completing missions and defeating enemies until your hero reaches level 25.

achievements.description: Reach Level 50.
achievements.summary: Raise your hero to level 50.

steps.text: Keep earning experience in missions until your hero reaches level 50.

achievements.description: Find and open your first 'fancy' treasure chest.
achievements.summary: Open a fancy treasure chest.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Squid Coast}, roll from the right edge onto the small island and open the chest. Other fancy chests in missions also count.

achievements.description: Open 100 treasure chests.
achievements.summary: Open 100 treasure chests.

steps.text: Open treasure chests while exploring missions until you have opened 100.

achievements.description: Collect a total of 1,000 emeralds.
achievements.summary: Collect 1,000 emeralds in total.

steps.text: Break emerald jars, open chests, collect enemy drops, and salvage unwanted equipment until your total collected reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Collect a total of 5,000 emeralds.
achievements.summary: Collect 5,000 emeralds in total.

steps.text: Keep collecting emeralds from jars, chests, enemies, and salvaged equipment until your lifetime total reaches 5,000.

achievements.description: Eat 200 food items.
achievements.summary: Consume 200 food drops.

steps.text: Pick up and eat food dropped by enemies. Armor with @mechanic{Food Reserves} supplies extra food whenever you drink a healing potion.

achievements.description: Complete Squid Coast and set up camp.
achievements.summary: Finish Squid Coast and establish your camp.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Squid Coast} tutorial. If you skipped the tutorial, start an offline game, select @mechanic{Default} difficulty, and choose Squid Coast on the Mainland map.

achievements.description: Complete Creeper Woods.
achievements.summary: Finish the Creeper Woods mission.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Creeper Woods}.

achievements.description: Complete Pumpkin Pastures and Soggy Swamp.
achievements.summary: Finish both Pumpkin Pastures and Soggy Swamp.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Pumpkin Pastures} and @loc{Soggy Swamp}.

achievements.displayName: Built On Sand, Set in Stone
achievements.description: Complete Redstone Mines and Cacti Canyon.
achievements.summary: Finish both Redstone Mines and Cacti Canyon.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Redstone Mines} and @loc{Cacti Canyon}.

achievements.description: Complete Desert Temple, Fiery Forge and Highblock Halls.
achievements.summary: Finish Highblock Halls, Desert Temple, and Fiery Forge.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Highblock Halls}, @loc{Desert Temple}, and @loc{Fiery Forge}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Arch-Illager at the Obsidian Pinnacle.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Arch-Illager at Obsidian Pinnacle.

steps.text: Reach the final battle in @loc{Obsidian Pinnacle}. Defeat the @enemy{Arch-Illager}, then the @enemy{Heart of Ender}.
Use ranged attacks during openings and move between the Heart of Ender's rotating beams. After the battle, approach the Arch-Illager to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Defeat the Arch-Illager on Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: Win the Arch-Illager battle at Apocalypse difficulty.

steps.text: Finish Obsidian Pinnacle on Default to open Adventure, then finish Obsidian Pinnacle on Adventure to open Apocalypse.
Complete @loc{Obsidian Pinnacle} on @mechanic{Apocalypse}, defeating both the Arch-Illager and the Heart of Ender. Use ranged attacks while avoiding the Heart of Ender's beams.

achievements.description: Kill any 10 mobs at once with TNT.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 10 enemies in one TNT explosion.

steps.text: Collect TNT from enemies or chests. Draw at least 10 enemies into a group, then throw the TNT into the group and keep the enemies inside the blast area.

achievements.description: Equip a gear set consisting of fully enchanted items (3 enchantment slots upgraded to level 3).
achievements.summary: Equip melee and ranged weapons and armor with all three enchantment slots upgraded to tier III.

steps.text: Obtain a melee weapon, ranged weapon, and armor that each have three enchantment slots.
Choose an enchantment in every slot and upgrade all nine to tier III, then equip the three pieces. Nine common enchantments require 54 points; powerful enchantments cost more.

achievements.description: Enchant an item and upgrade the enchantment to Tier 3.
achievements.summary: Raise an equipment enchantment to tier III.

steps.text: Spend enchantment points on one equipment enchantment until it reaches tier III. A common enchantment needs 6 points in total; a powerful enchantment needs 9.

achievements.description: Use artifacts to summon the Wolf, Llama and Iron Golem allies at least once each.
achievements.summary: Summon a wolf, a llama, and an iron golem with artifacts at least once each.

steps.text: Obtain and activate @item{Tasty Bone} for a wolf, @item{Wonderful Wheat} for a llama, and @item{Golem Kit} for an iron golem. Check mission rewards and camp merchants for the artifacts.

achievements.description: Complete Overgrown Temple on Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: At Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty, finish the mission Overgrown Temple.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to @mechanic{Adventure} or @mechanic{Apocalypse}. Complete @loc{Overgrown Temple}, including its @enemy{Jungle Abomination} boss.

achievements.description: Complete the Panda Plateau secret mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Panda Plateau secret mission.

steps.text: In @loc{Dingy Jungle}, explore the side route during @mechanic{Cross the Canyon}. Enter the dungeon at the end and clear its ambush.
Press the buttons on the three panda shrines to open the barrier, then collect the @item{Panda Plateau scroll}. If the side route is absent, restart Dingy Jungle.
Select @loc{Panda Plateau} on the map and complete the mission.

achievements.description: Wear the Ocelot Armour and complete any mission featuring Ocelots without killing any of them.
achievements.summary: Finish an ocelot mission in Ocelot Armor without changing armor or killing any ocelots.

steps.text: Equip @item{Ocelot Armor} before starting @loc{Overgrown Temple}, @loc{Dingy Jungle}, or @loc{Panda Plateau}. Finish without swapping armor or killing an ocelot; draw enemies away from nearby ocelots. If an ocelot dies or you change armor, replay the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Dingy Jungle without using a healing potion or losing a life.
achievements.summary: Finish Dingy Jungle with no life lost and no healing potion used.

steps.text: Play @loc{Dingy Jungle} on a comfortable difficulty and heal with food drops. Reach the exit with no life lost and no healing potion used. If either restriction fails, replay Dingy Jungle.

achievements.description: Defeat the Mooshroom Monstrosity using only gear unique to the jungle.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Mooshroom Monstrosity with only jungle gear equipped.

steps.text: After finishing @loc{Obsidian Pinnacle}, use the spring platforms east of your camp home. Follow the hidden forest path south, then west, to the church, @loc{Great Hall}. Press the button at the rear to enable the rune rooms.
In @loc{Creeper Woods}, go left of the caravan near the mission ending and enter the hole. Collect the rune from the platform inside.
In @loc{Pumpkin Pastures}, find crates beside a stone-brick wall. Press the button behind the crates to move the darker bricks, then enter and collect the rune.
In @loc{Soggy Swamp}, find the tower right of the mission exit. Press the button among the mushrooms at its base and collect the rune beyond the cliff door.
In @loc{Redstone Mines}, search the far-left edge of the area where you rescue six villagers. Press the hidden button to open the wall and collect the rune.
In @loc{Fiery Forge}, look for a lever beside the Redstone Golem when you enter the first brightly lit passage. Pull the lever and collect the rune behind the opened wall.
In @loc{Cacti Canyon}, press the button behind the palm tree left of the blue Key Golem room entrance. Enter the wall opening behind the key and collect the rune.
In @loc{Desert Temple}, search the room before the Key Golem. Pull the wall lever beside the bush and palm tree, then collect the rune in the opened passage.
In @loc{Highblock Halls}, climb the far-right outdoor stairs. Use the unlit torch as a lever and collect the rune behind the wall.
In @loc{Obsidian Pinnacle}, enter the study in the Cellar and activate the book on the bookcase. Collect the rune in the room with two chests.
Return to @loc{Great Hall} and open the rear room after collecting the nine mission runes. Take the scroll to unlock @loc{???}.

Get a @item{Whip} and @item{Ocelot Armor}; Tower rewards can supply both without Jungle Awakens. Equip only those two items, leaving your ranged weapon and every artifact slot empty. In ???, defeat the @enemy{Mooshroom Monstrosity}.

achievements.description: Complete Lone Fortress on Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: At Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty, finish the mission Lone Fortress.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to @mechanic{Adventure} or @mechanic{Apocalypse}. Finish @loc{Lone Fortress} by defeating the @enemy{Wretched Wraith} and reaching the exit.

achievements.description: Complete the Lost Settlement secret mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Lost Settlement secret mission.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Frosted Fjord} until you find the area with three switches. Open the dungeon and check the paths inside for a further entrance leading to the @item{Lost Settlement scroll}. Replay Frosted Fjord if the entrance is absent.
Collect the scroll, then select and complete @loc{Lost Settlement}.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 mobs with a single Ice Wand attack
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies with one Ice Wand attack.

steps.text: Obtain an @item{Ice Wand} from a Creeping Winter mission or receive one from another player through the @npc{Gift Wrapper}. On a low difficulty, gather five enemies and kill the group with one Ice Wand attack.

achievements.description: Slide a total distance of 500 blocks on ice.
achievements.summary: Slide 500 blocks across ice in total.

steps.text: Move across icy ground in winter missions until you have slid 500 blocks in total.

achievements.description: Complete Frosted Fjord without having a melee or ranged weapon equipped at any time.
achievements.summary: Finish Frosted Fjord without ever having a melee weapon and a ranged weapon equipped together.

steps.text: Remove both weapons before entering @loc{Frosted Fjord}, and leave both slots empty for the whole mission. Use armor and summoning artifacts to handle combat; choose a low difficulty. If you equip both weapons, replay Frosted Fjord.

achievements.description: Complete Gale Sanctum on Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: At Adventure or Apocalypse difficulty, finish the mission Gale Sanctum.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to @mechanic{Adventure} or @mechanic{Apocalypse}, then complete @loc{Gale Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Complete the Colossal Rampart secret mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Colossal Rampart secret mission.

steps.text: In @loc{Windswept Peaks}, pass the elevator and look for a fork with an uphill route and a downhill route. Take the downhill route into the dungeon, clear the ambushes, and collect the @item{Colossal Rampart scroll}. Restart Windswept Peaks if the branch is absent.
Complete the newly unlocked @loc{Colossal Rampart} mission.

achievements.description: Using the Tempest Knife, defeat 10 Mountaineer mobs within 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Mountaineers within 10 seconds using only a regular Tempest Knife.

steps.text: Obtain a regular @item{Tempest Knife}; Tower rewards can provide one without Howling Peaks. The knife's unique variants do not count.
Enter the free @loc{Gauntlet of Gales} on a low difficulty. Gather Mountaineers and kill 10 within 10 seconds using only the knife. If the timer expires, find another group or replay.

achievements.displayName: A Taste Of Their Own Medicine
achievements.description: Using the Updraft Tome, cast Updraft on three Wind Callers at once.
achievements.summary: Hit three Wind Callers at once with the Updraft Tome.

steps.text: Obtain an @item{Updraft Tome} from the free @loc{Gauntlet of Gales}. In that mission, find three Wind Callers close together and cast the tome once with all three inside its range. If the group separates, try another group or replay.

achievements.description: Find the chamber dedicated to the humble Llama and make an offering.
achievements.summary: Complete the wind puzzle in the hidden llama chamber.

steps.text: In @loc{Gale Sanctum}, descend to the second level with three launch pads and search the far end for @loc{Llama Lock-in}. Inside, use the button to send wind through every tube and drop wheat into the llama grinder.

achievements.description: Defeat a Ravager and a Squall Golem within 5 seconds of each other.
achievements.summary: Kill a Ravager and a Squall Golem no more than five seconds apart.

steps.text: In @loc{Gale Sanctum}, reach the area with three beacons and keep a Ravager alive. Activate a Squall Golem and bring the enemies together, then kill both within five seconds. Use a low difficulty; replay if both targets are no longer available.

achievements.description: Defeat the Tempest Golem while four pets are active.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Tempest Golem with four summoned allies active.

steps.text: Bring @item{Tasty Bone}, @item{Wonderful Wheat}, and @item{Golem Kit}, plus @item{Spelunker Armor} for its bat.

At the @enemy{Tempest Golem} fight in @loc{Gale Sanctum}, activate the artifacts for an iron golem, wolf, and llama. Keep those allies and the bat active as the boss dies. Cosmetic pets do not count; replay the fight if fewer than four allies remain.

achievements.description: Complete Obsidian Pinnacle on Apocalypse Plus 5 difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Obsidian Pinnacle on Apocalypse Plus 5 or 6.

steps.text: Complete a mission on Apocalypse VII to open Apocalypse Plus. Clear the boss missions shown by the difficulty slider at the highest available Plus tier until Plus 5 opens.
Select @mechanic{Apocalypse Plus 5} for @loc{Obsidian Pinnacle} and complete the mission, defeating both final boss phases.

achievements.description: Complete a Daily Trial with a level III challenge while wearing Emerald Gear.
achievements.summary: Finish a tier III Daily Trial while wearing Emerald Gear or one of its unique variants.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Gilded Glory}, @item{Emerald Gear}, or @item{Opulent Armor}; Tower rewards can supply this armor without Howling Peaks. Equip the armor and complete a green @mechanic{III} Daily Trial on the mission map.

achievements.description: Save yourself by using the Death Barter enchantment twice in a single mission.
achievements.summary: Trigger Death Barter twice during one mission.

steps.text: Equip armor with @mechanic{Death Barter} and upgrade the enchantment to tier III.

During one mission, collect 50 emeralds and take lethal damage to trigger Death Barter. Collect another 50 emeralds and trigger Death Barter a second time. If the mission ends first, start a new attempt.

achievements.description: Complete Nether Wastes on Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Nether Wastes on Apocalypse difficulty.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Nether Wastes} on @mechanic{Apocalypse}.

achievements.description: Complete all secret Nether levels on any Apocalypse Plus difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish every secret Nether mission on Apocalypse I or higher.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Nether Wastes} to open Basalt Deltas and Warped Forest. Collect the @loc{Nether Fortress} scroll in Basalt Deltas and the @loc{Crimson Forest} scroll in Warped Forest.
Collect the @loc{Soul Sand Valley} scroll while playing Crimson Forest.
Complete @loc{Soul Sand Valley}, @loc{Nether Fortress}, and @loc{Crimson Forest} on @mechanic{Apocalypse I} or higher.

achievements.description: Defeat 15 different ancient mobs.
achievements.summary: Defeat 15 distinct types of ancient mobs.

steps.text: Clear a mission at Default V or above to unlock @mechanic{Ancient Hunts}. At camp, enter the Ancient Hunt portal and offer equipment to choose the runes for the hunt.
Use different rune combinations across hunts to reach different ancient dungeons. Enter hunt doors, defeat the ancient bosses, and track their names until you have killed 15 distinct types.

achievements.description: Collect 500 gold over time.
achievements.summary: Collect 500 gold in total.

steps.text: Explore @mechanic{Ancient Hunts} and open the piglin chests in gold rooms until you have collected 500 gold. The total can span multiple hunts.

achievements.description: Have 6 merchants in your camp at once.
achievements.summary: Have the six original camp merchants present together.

steps.text: Rescue the @npc{Village Merchant} in Creeper Woods, @npc{Gift Wrapper} in Soggy Swamp, @npc{Mystery Merchant} in Pumpkin Pastures, @npc{Blacksmith} in Redstone Mines, and @npc{Luxury Merchant} in Cacti Canyon.
Collect gold in an @mechanic{Ancient Hunt} to add the @npc{Piglin Merchant}. Have all six merchants at camp together.

achievements.description: Activate the Gong of Weakening 6 times in 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Activate the Gong of Weakening six times within five seconds.

steps.text: Equip three @item{Gongs of Weakening} and armor with @mechanic{Final Shout}. Let enemies lower your health to slightly above 25%.
Activate the three gongs manually, then take damage below 25% health so Final Shout activates the gongs again. Fit all six activations inside five seconds; try again if the timing fails.

achievements.description: Achieve 70 hits with a single activation of the Spinblade.
achievements.summary: Land 70 hits from a single Spinblade activation.

steps.text: Get a @item{Spinblade} from Nether Wastes or Basalt Deltas, or receive one from another player through the @npc{Gift Wrapper}.
On a low difficulty, draw at least 35 enemies into a dense group. Throw the Spinblade through the group so the outward and returning passes each hit the enemies.

achievements.description: Complete two Ancient Hunts and two Daily Trials, in two-player co-op, on the second day of the month
achievements.summary: Finish two Daily Trials plus two Ancient Hunts in two-player co-op on a month's second day.

steps.text: On the second calendar day of a month, play two-player co-op and finish two @mechanic{Daily Trials} plus two @mechanic{Ancient Hunts}. Local co-op with a second controller works; keep both players in the mission when completing each run.

achievements.description: During Ancient Hunts, bring a wolf, a bat, and a soul entity to visit familiar locations.
achievements.summary: Visit the matching Ancient Hunt locations with a summoned wolf, bat, and soul entity.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Tasty Bone}, @item{Spelunker Armor}, and a @item{Soul Lantern} before starting Ancient Hunts.
Summon the wolf beside the wolf den near the portal in the Creeper Woods section. Bring the armor’s bat to the Spider Cave entrance where bats fly out.
Summon the soul entity beside the wall made of soul sand in the Soul Sand Valley section. Run more Ancient Hunts if a required location does not appear.

achievements.description: Equip a gilded, unique, fully enchanted weapon.
achievements.summary: Equip a unique gilded weapon with every enchantment slot fully upgraded.

steps.text: Find a unique gilded melee or ranged weapon with three enchantment slots from an Ancient Hunt or the Piglin Merchant.
Choose one enchantment in each slot, upgrade each chosen enchantment to its maximum tier, and equip the weapon.

achievements.description: Complete Abyssal Monument on Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Abyssal Monument on Apocalypse difficulty.

steps.text: Select @loc{Abyssal Monument} on Apocalypse difficulty and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Radiant Ravine secret mission on any Apocalypse Plus difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Radiant Ravine on an Apocalypse Plus difficulty.

steps.text: Find the large side dungeon in @loc{Coral Rise}. Clear the ambush with the Drowned Necromancer, then use the clams to reach the Radiant Ravine mission scroll.
Finish @loc{Radiant Ravine} on any Apocalypse Plus setting. Replay Coral Rise if the large dungeon does not appear.

achievements.description: Defeat a glow squid with the Ice Wand artifact.
achievements.summary: Defeat a glow squid with an Ice Wand.

steps.text: Receive an @item{Ice Wand} from another player through the @npc{Gift Wrapper} in Camp, then equip the artifact.
At the secret glow squid party dock in @loc{Squid Coast}, use the Ice Wand to defeat a glow squid.

achievements.description: Hit each type of underwater mob with the fishing rod.
achievements.summary: Hit every type of underwater mob with a Fishing Rod.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Fishing Rod} for the Hidden Depths missions. Hook drowned, baby drowned, armored drowned, trident drowned, and armored trident drowned.
Hook sunken skeletons and armored sunken skeletons, a wavewhisperer, a guardian, and large, medium, and small tropical slimes.
Hook a pufferfish, turtle, baby turtle, dolphin, squid, and glow squid. Glow squids appear in Radiant Ravine.
Continue exploring underwater missions until every listed type has been hooked. Drowned Necromancers, Elder Guardians, and the Eponymous Squid are excluded.

achievements.description: Return the lost conduit in Radiant Ravine.
achievements.summary: Return Radiant Ravine’s lost conduit to its matching pedestal.

steps.text: In @loc{Radiant Ravine}, check the side route after the first drop and before the second drop. Both drops prevent backtracking. Take the lost conduit from this route. If you pass the second drop without the conduit, restart Radiant Ravine.
During “Survive the Gauntlet,” find the volcanic branch around the section’s midpoint. Carry the conduit into this branch and set the conduit on the pedestal.

achievements.description: Spend five minutes in a bubble column.
achievements.summary: Remain in an underwater bubble column for five minutes.

steps.text: Stand inside a bubble column in a Hidden Depths mission for five minutes.

achievements.description: Survive without oxygen for 60 seconds.
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 60 seconds with an empty oxygen meter.

steps.text: Equip three @item{Totems of Regeneration} and enter an underwater mission.
Let the oxygen meter empty away from bubble columns. Alternate the totems and your healing potion to survive for 60 seconds.

achievements.description: Defeat 10 mobs with a single Trident explosion.
achievements.summary: Defeat at least 10 mobs with one Trident explosion.

steps.text: Pick up a dropped @item{Trident}. In Radiant Ravine, split tropical slimes into small slimes and gather at least 10 together.
Throw the Trident into the group so the explosion defeats at least 10 mobs. You can also attempt this on a Tower floor that provides Tridents.

achievements.description: Complete 10 missions where the difficulty has been modified by a Raid Captain's Banner.
achievements.summary: Finish 10 missions with a Raid Captain’s Banner modifying the difficulty.

steps.text: Defeat a @enemy{Raid Captain}, pick up the dropped banner, and finish the mission with the added threat or modifier.
Finish 10 missions in which you collected at least one banner; several banners in one mission still give one mission completion.

achievements.description: Using the Bubble Bow, have 10 mobs bubbled at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep 10 mobs trapped in Bubble Bow bubbles at the same time.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Bubble Bow}, preferably with Piercing, from Coral Rise, Abyssal Monument, or a Tower reward.
Gather a large group of enemies and shoot through the group until at least 10 are trapped in bubbles together.

achievements.description: Travel through the End Portal to the End Wilds.
achievements.summary: Enter the End Wilds through the Stronghold’s End Portal.

steps.text: Visit @loc{The Stronghold}, then return to the mainland map. Explore the six missions marked with an Eye of Ender and defeat each hidden Endersent to collect the six eyes.
Return the eyes to the Stronghold’s portal and enter the portal to start @loc{End Wilds}.

achievements.description: Enter the Stronghold Vault.
achievements.summary: Enter the hidden vault in the Stronghold.

guide.context: Entering the End Portal starts End Wilds, so explore the vault before leaving through the portal.

steps.text: Collect the six Eyes of Ender from the mainland Endersent and bring the eyes to @loc{The Stronghold} to open the sealed side areas.
Explore the unlocked areas and press the six hidden buttons. Enter the newly opened vault door in the End Portal room.

achievements.description: Defeat the final boss of Broken Citadel.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Vengeful Heart of Ender.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Broken Citadel} and defeat its final boss, the @enemy{Vengeful Heart of Ender}.

achievements.description: Unlock all mission item drops in the base game and DLCs.
achievements.summary: Discover every mission item drop across the base game and all six story expansions.

steps.text: Open each mission’s details on the map and check the equipment and artifact drops. Dark silhouettes mark drops you have not collected.
Replay missions with undiscovered drops until every listed weapon, armor, and artifact is revealed across the mainland and all six story expansions.

achievements.description: Reach the top of the Broken Citadel without ever getting hit by a Shulker.
achievements.summary: Reach the top of Broken Citadel without being hit by a shulker projectile.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Broken Citadel} with a @item{Totem of Shielding}. Wait for the totem to recharge before entering exposed areas.
Dodge shulker projectiles and avoid Snareling webs while climbing to the top. If a shulker projectile hits you, restart Broken Citadel for another attempt.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 1000 Enderlings (Watchling, Blastling, Snareling) with an Obsidian Claymore.
achievements.summary: Defeat 1,000 Enderlings with an Obsidian Claymore or The Starless Night.

steps.text: Collect an @item{Obsidian Claymore} or @item{The Starless Night} from End Wilds or Broken Citadel, then equip the weapon.
Replay the End missions and defeat 1,000 Watchlings, Blastlings, and Snarelings with the weapon. Endermites do not count.

achievements.description: Survive being afflicted by Voided x999.
achievements.summary: Survive until a Voided status effect that reached x999 has worn off.

guide.context: Voided increases damage taken, so clear nearby enemies before building the effect.

steps.text: Clear enemies away from a patch of glowing purple ground in @loc{End Wilds} or @loc{Broken Citadel}.
Stand on the purple ground until @mechanic{Voided} reaches x999, then leave the ground and stay alive until the effect expires. If you die, attempt the challenge again.

achievements.description: Using the Elytra, dive attack 12 enemies at once.
achievements.summary: Hit at least 12 enemies with one Elytra dive attack.

steps.text: On a low difficulty in the End missions, gather at least 12 enemies near a firework launch station.
Launch into the air with the Elytra, then hold the attack control to dive into the group.

achievements.description: After consuming a Burning Brew, defeat a Mob using a weapon with the Fire Aspect enchantment.
achievements.summary: Defeat a mob with a Fire Aspect weapon while Burning Brew is active.

steps.text: Equip a weapon with @mechanic{Fire Aspect} and play @loc{The Stronghold} until an enemy drops a @item{Burning Brew}.
Drink the brew, then defeat an enemy with the weapon while the brew is active. Make the weapon’s hit finish the enemy before the brew’s damage does.

achievements.description: Find the secret squid encounter in Squid Coast.
achievements.summary: Trigger the hidden glow squid party in Squid Coast.

steps.text: Choose Default difficulty to replay @loc{Squid Coast}. Stand in the sunflower patches to reveal buttons, then press the buttons in this order.
First: immediately right after the second stone bridge, near the lighthouse. Second: in the large pond on the right near the end of the mission.
Third: backtrack to the stone bridge with the large waterfall, then turn left and go behind the trees. Fourth: behind the statue beside the stairs in the arena.
Return to the start and roll to the small island on the right. Walk onto the dock to meet the squid. A cow sound after a button means the order was wrong; repeat the sequence.

achievements.description: Acquire a melee weapon, ranged weapon, armor, and artifact while climbing the tower.
achievements.summary: Acquire a melee weapon, a ranged weapon, armor, and an artifact from Tower floor rewards.

steps.text: After clearing Tower floors, choose rewards until you have taken one melee weapon, one ranged weapon, one armor piece, and one artifact across your runs.

achievements.description: Make a purchase from each of the tower's vendors.
achievements.summary: Use the services of each of the Tower’s three merchants.

steps.text: During Tower runs, have the @npc{Powersmith}, @npc{Uniquesmith}, and @npc{Gildsmith} each upgrade one of your equipment pieces.

achievements.description: Complete a tower run on Adventure difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish a Tower run on Adventure difficulty.

steps.text: Select Adventure difficulty for the @loc{Tower} and clear the run’s final boss floor.

achievements.description: Complete a tower run on Apocalypse difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish a Tower run on Apocalypse difficulty.

steps.text: Select Apocalypse difficulty for the @loc{Tower} and clear every floor through the final boss.

achievements.description: Enter the secret room beneath the Tower entrance.
achievements.summary: Enter the hidden room below the Tower entrance in Camp.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Light Feather}. Stand on the small steps around the left corner of the Tower entrance in Camp, then hop over the wooden railing with the feather.
Drop onto the roof with the chimney. From its lower-left corner, roll diagonally toward the wall to land on the lower roof, then move right to the next roof.
Walk carefully off the back-right edge onto the wooden platform below, then enter the door. If you fall out of Camp, return to the Tower entrance and try the route again.

achievements.description: Reach seasonal adventure rank 10.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 10 in a seasonal adventure.

steps.text: Select a season at the @loc{Adventure Hub}. Earn adventure points from missions, Tower runs, and weekly challenges until the selected season reaches rank 10.

achievements.description: Reach seasonal adventure rank 25.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 25 in a seasonal adventure.

steps.text: Keep earning adventure points in the same selected season through missions, Tower runs, and weekly challenges until rank 25.

achievements.description: Complete Gauntlet of Gales on Apocalypse difficulty with the golden parrot as your companion
achievements.summary: Finish the Apocalypse version of Gauntlet of Gales with the Golden Parrot cosmetic pet active.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Cloudy Climb} at the Adventure Hub and reach rank 45 to unlock the free @item{Golden Parrot} pet.
Equip the Golden Parrot in the cosmetics menu. Select Apocalypse for @loc{Gauntlet of Gales} and finish the mission with the pet active.

achievements.description: Clear 100 Tower floors.
achievements.summary: Clear a total of 100 Tower floors.

steps.text: Continue Tower runs until you have cleared 100 floors in total. Floors from failed runs still count.

achievements.description: "Who's a good wolf? You are! Yes, you are."
achievements.summary: Pet a wolf in Camp.

steps.text: Approach a wolf in @loc{Camp} and use the interaction prompt to pet the wolf.

achievements.description: Complete a mission with a full set of cosmetics (Cape, Pet, Emote, Flairs) from a previous season.
achievements.summary: Finish a mission wearing a cape, pet, emote, and flair earned from Cloudy Climb.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Cloudy Climb} and earn one cosmetic for each required category. The free track gives the Knight emote at rank 4, Thunder Crack flair at rank 12, Golden Parrot pet at rank 45, and Downpour Cape at rank 50.
Equip those four Cloudy Climb cosmetics in the inventory’s cosmetics tab and finish any mission.

achievements.description: Defeat the Redstone Monstrosity with any Ministrosity Pet equipped.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Redstone Monstrosity with a Ministrosity pet equipped.

steps.text: Reach rank 4 in @mechanic{Luminous Night} to unlock the free @item{Stone Ministrosity} pet and equip the pet in the cosmetics menu.
Finish @loc{Fiery Forge} and defeat the @enemy{Redstone Monstrosity} while the pet is equipped.

achievements.description: Use the Abomination Roar emote at the Jungle Abomination.
achievements.summary: Perform Abomination Roar during a fight against the Jungle Abomination.

steps.text: Reach rank 16 on @mechanic{Luminous Night} to unlock the free @item{Abomination Roar} emote, then equip the emote.
Enter @loc{Overgrown Temple} and use Abomination Roar during the fight with the @enemy{Jungle Abomination}.

achievements.description: Encounter 15 different biomes in your Tower adventures.
achievements.summary: Visit 15 distinct biomes across Tower runs.

steps.text: Play Tower layouts and enter floors with different environments until you have visited 15 biomes in total. Return after the Tower layout changes if your current layout has no new environments.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Weekly Challenges.
achievements.summary: Finish 10 weekly challenges.

steps.text: Check weekly challenges at the @loc{Adventure Hub} and complete 10 objectives across weekly resets. Six challenges are available per week, so allow at least two weeks.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Daily Trials in 1 day.
achievements.summary: Finish three Daily Trials in one day.

steps.text: Complete the two @mechanic{Daily Trials} marked on the Mainland map. For the third completion, finish one of those trials again on another difficulty before the daily reset. If the day changes before you have three completions, earn three completions on a new day.

achievements.description: Complete Cacti Canyon in under 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Finish Cacti Canyon in less than five minutes.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Cacti Canyon} on a low difficulty with Boots of Swiftness and a Ghost Cloak. Run past optional fights and finish before five minutes; replay the mission if you take too long.

achievements.description: Complete Creeper Woods on Apocalypse difficulty, without defeating any mobs.
achievements.summary: Finish an Apocalypse run of Creeper Woods with no mob kills.

steps.text: Select Apocalypse I for @loc{Creeper Woods}. Use Boots of Swiftness and a Ghost Cloak to pass enemies without attacking, then complete the objectives and reach the exit. Restart the mission if you defeat a mob.

achievements.description: Store 50 items in the Storage Chest.
achievements.summary: Keep 50 items in the Storage Chest.

steps.text: Use the @item{Storage Chest} near the Village Merchant in Camp and transfer 50 weapons, armor pieces, or artifacts into storage.

achievements.description: Defeat 10 Wildfires.
achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 10 Wildfires.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Wildfires} until your total reaches 10. Find these minibosses in Flames of the Nether missions such as Nether Fortress, or on Tower floors that contain Wildfires.

achievements.description: Complete Desert Temple in under 4 minutes.
achievements.summary: Finish Desert Temple in less than four minutes.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Desert Temple} on a low difficulty with three Boots of Swiftness and cooldown-reducing armor such as an Evocation Robe. Alternate the boots and run through the objectives to finish under four minutes; replay the mission if you miss the time.

achievements.description: Make use of the Enchantsmith's services 3 times.
achievements.summary: Reroll enchantments through the Enchantsmith three times.

steps.text: Rescue the @npc{Enchantsmith} from the courtyard in @loc{Highblock Halls}. Find the merchant down the southwest stairs in Camp.
Bring gold and use the Enchantsmith to reroll an enchantment three times.

achievements.description: Complete Treetop Tangle wearing the Root Rot armor.
achievements.summary: Finish Treetop Tangle wearing Root Rot Armor or Black Spot Armor.

steps.text: Collect @item{Root Rot Armor} from Treetop Tangle, equip the armor, and replay the mission through its ending. @item{Black Spot Armor} also counts.

achievements.description: Complete Treetop Tangle on any Apocalypse Plus difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Treetop Tangle on an Apocalypse Plus difficulty.

steps.text: Select any Apocalypse Plus setting for @loc{Treetop Tangle} and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Lower Temple on Apocalypse difficulty with the desert rabbit as your companion.
achievements.summary: Finish an Apocalypse run of Lower Temple while accompanied by the Desert Rabbit cosmetic pet.

steps.text: Reach rank 13 on the free @mechanic{Fauna Faire} reward track, then equip the @item{Desert Rabbit} cosmetic pet.
Find the mission scroll in Desert Temple to unlock @loc{Lower Temple}. With the rabbit equipped, select Apocalypse for Lower Temple and complete the mission.

achievements.description: Use the Horse Ride emote at a Skeleton Horseman.
achievements.summary: Use the Horse Ride emote near a Skeleton Horseman.

steps.text: Reach rank 20 on the free @mechanic{Fauna Faire} reward track and equip the @item{Horse Ride} emote.
Use Horse Ride when a @enemy{Skeleton Horseman} miniboss appears. Skeleton Horsemen are random encounters, so keep playing missions until you meet one.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 Tower Guards.
achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 100 Tower Guards.

steps.text: Play Tower layouts that contain @enemy{Tower Guards} and defeat these armored guards until the total reaches 100. If the current layout has none, return after the layout changes.

achievements.description: Use the Soul Totem of Casting 50 times.
achievements.summary: Activate the Totem of Casting 50 times.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Treetop Tangle} for a chance to receive the @item{Totem of Casting} artifact.
Equip the totem with gear that gathers souls. Defeat enemies to collect souls and activate the artifact whenever charged, until you have used the totem 50 times.

achievements.description: Complete a tower without using the services of the Guildsmith, Enchantsmith and Powersmith.
achievements.summary: Finish a Tower run without using any Tower merchant services.

steps.text: Clear a Tower run without asking the @npc{Gildsmith}, @npc{Uniquesmith}, or @npc{Powersmith} to improve equipment. Floor reward choices are allowed. If you use a merchant service, restart the Tower run.

achievements.displayName: A, B, Bee, Bee, Bee, Bee, Bee
achievements.description: Summon 15 Bees at once.
achievements.summary: Have 15 summoned bees active at the same time.

steps.text: Equip two @item{Buzzy Nests}, a melee weapon with @mechanic{Busy Bee}, and Beenest Armor or Beehive Armor with @mechanic{Tumblebee}.

Use both nests to summon six bees. Take hits to summon three armor bees, roll to summon three Tumblebee bees, and defeat enemies with the melee weapon to summon three Busy Bee bees. Keep the groups alive together until 15 bees are present.
